name: ai-video-model-benchmark
description: A benchmark suite for evaluating AI video models on generation, editing and fidelity-to-prompt capabilities, measuring perceptual realism, temporal coherence, and alignment with input prompts. It combines automated perceptual metrics and human judgments to compare models across common failure modes (flicker, object consistency, and motion plausibility). The benchmark is intended to guide development of video generative and conditional-video models.
evaluation_method: human_eval (augmented with FID / LPIPS / CLIP-based alignment scores)
reputation: Relatively new and niche; used by researchers and practitioners working on video generation but not yet a broadly adopted, canonical benchmark.
